subject.title: feat: add metadata-only message audit events

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt this default-off message lifecycle audit contract and its same-database pseudonymous correlation model?
rationale: The PR introduces a permanent privacy-sensitive configuration option, persisted data model, and public gateway contract; implementation tests cannot choose whether those should become supported core product boundaries.

options.title: Adopt the bounded core ledger
options.body: Accept the default-off metadata-only contract after the resolved exact head has convincing live and upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow correlation metadata
options.body: Keep lifecycle outcomes but reduce or remove stable pseudonymous identifiers before adopting the core contract.

options.title: Pause the core expansion
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open without landing durable message metadata until the product direction changes.

recommendation.title: Adopt the bounded core ledger
recommendation.body: Accept the default-off metadata-only contract after the resolved exact head has convincing live and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged audit foundation and the strongest current history across the affected audit, state, gateway, and outbound boundaries trace to this person.
